advancements.guhs.knabbelring.root.title: The Lord of the Nibble Ring
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.root.descr: One nibble to share them all. Guhdalf is waiting for you at the big Barbecue Pit
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sam_guh: Rarity: One per player, after the story of the Nibble Ring
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sam_guh: Sam-guh, the faithful gardener guh of the Nibble Shire. He walks the whole journey with you with all his pans on his back, cooks a stew at every rest stop and always knows what to do next. When the ring gets too heavy, he carries you. Nyeg!
advancements.guhs.verhalen.ring_getemd.d: Take Sam-guh home with you (one time only, just for you)
gui.guhs.verhaal.kopie.sam_guh: Nyeg, boss? I'll mind the pans. Come back in a bit.
gui.guhs.kledingbron.ring: The Lord of the Nibble Ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.kop.knabbelring: The Lord of the Nibble Ring
gui.guhs.verhalen.doelregel.tooltip: Turn the little line in the top left of your screen on or off: it tells you what to do now in the story you're following.
gui.guhs.verhalen.volg.gekozen: ✔ You're following this story (click: back to automatic)
gui.guhs.verhalen.volg.vanzelf: ✔ You're following this story automatically (click: pin)
gui.guhs.verhalen.volg.tooltip: The objective on your screen and "My Story" in the Super Compass will then point to this story. Nyeg, handy!
gui.guhs.verhalen.geheim.tooltip: This comes later in the story. Just a little patience, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.reiskaart.tooltip: Click for the map of your journey: where you are and what to do now
gui.guhs.verhalen.kaart.klaar: The whole journey is done. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.herbekijk.scene: Click to watch this scene again
gui.guhs.verhalen.herbekijk.kaart: Click to read this story card again
structure.guhs.@doel.tooltip: The compass automatically points to the next objective of the story you're following. If you need to go to another world, it points to the portal.
gui.guhs.verhaal.kompas.geen: Your story isn't pointing anywhere right now
gui.guhs.verhaal.kompas.portaal: %s: first go through the portal the compass is pointing to
gui.guhs.verhaal.kompas.elders: %s: that's in another world. Find a portal, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhaal.kompas.zoek: %s: the compass can't find it here
quest.guhs.verhaal.sluier: Guhdalf thinks you're not ready for this yet, nyeg
gui.guhs.verhaal.beschermd: Nothing to break or build here: this is part of the story, nyeg
guhs.configuration.objectiveLine.tooltip: Shows in the top left of your screen what to do now in the story you're following. The Tales tab of the Guhdex has a button for it too.
gui.guhs.wereld.beschermd: This is part of the building: you can't break or place anything here. Nyeg!
item.guhs.knabbelring.lore: One nibble to share them all. It smells delicious. Too delicious, nyeg.
item.guhs.knabbelring.lore2: Right-click: put it on or take it off. On: Mikas can't see you.
item.guhs.knabbelring.lore3: But the Eye DOES see you, and in the Guhbarbecuether the Nine will come.
quest.guhs.ring.om: You put on the Nibble Ring. Nobody can see you... except the Eye.
quest.guhs.ring.af: You take off the Nibble Ring. Phew.
quest.guhs.ring.om.spel: Not during a game, nyeg: here the ring stays in your pocket.
quest.guhs.ring.portaal_dicht: Guhdalf has switched off this teleportation magic. Maybe you could help him by taking a ring along, since you're going on a journey anyway?
quest.guhs.ring.portaal_open: Guhdalf has switched the teleportation magic of the grill portal back on. For you, nyeg. The journey can begin!
quest.guhs.ring.wegwijs: Your story has begun! In the top left you can always see what to do. Your Journey Map is in the Guhdex (Tales tab), the Super Compass points to 'My Story' and Sam-guh always knows the way. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ring.beloning: The Nibble Ring has been fried and shared. You are now a Ring-Bearer! Sam-guh wants to come home with you (click him) and Smikagol will go fishing for you. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.ring.trek.0: The ring whispers: eat me... just one little bite... nobody's looking...
quest.guhs.ring.trek.1: The ring suddenly smells like melted cheese. It's doing that on purpose.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.2: Your tummy rumbles. The ring rumbles back.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.3: The ring whispers: I'm crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, nyeg...
quest.guhs.ring.trek.4: Was that a crumb? No. The ring doesn't crumble. It's only teasing.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.5: The ring whispers: Guhdalf doesn't need to know...
quest.guhs.ring.trek.6: You accidentally lick your pawsie. It tastes like ring. Wahoog, that's yummy.
quest.guhs.ring.trek.7: The ring gets a little warm in your pocket. It knows you're thinking about it.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.negen: The Nine have caught you! They shove you back to your last rest stop. Don't put that ring on, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.oog: The Eye has spotted you! With a single look you're back at your last rest stop.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.gevallen: Oops. Sam-guh picks you up and puts you back at your last rest stop.
quest.guhs.ring.negen.waarschuwing: It's getting cold... The Eye has spotted you. Take off the ring, quick!
quest.guhs.ring.negen.komen: The Nine are coming! Run, take off the ring or dazzle them with the Light Phial!
quest.guhs.ring.negen.kwijt: The Nine have lost you. They sniff around a bit more and slink off. Phew, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ring.negen.betrapt: A Skelly Mika Rider has spotted you!
quest.guhs.ring.doel.klaar: The journey is done and the ring has been shared. Now it's party time, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ring.doel.niet_begonnen: There's adventure in the air. Find Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit in the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.ring.doel.portaal: For that we have to go through the grill portal first. Your Super Compass points the way.
quest.guhs.ring.doel.hier: We're here: %s. Have a good look around.
quest.guhs.ring.doel.richting: To %1$s: that way, to the %2$s. About %3$s blocks to go.
item.guhs.lichtflesje.lore: The light of Guhladriel's favorite star, in a little phial. Right-click: a flash that blows smoke away and dazzles the Nine.
item.guhs.lichtflesje.lore2: In your hand it's a little lamp that walks along with you.
quest.guhs.ring.lichtflesje.verblind: Flash! The Skelly Mikas can't see a thing for a moment.
item.guhs.elfenmanteltje.lore: A little cloak from the tree guhs. Whoever carries it, sneaks and stands still looks like a rock.
item.guhs.elfenmanteltje.lore2: The Eye and the riders look right past a rock. After the story you also get it as clothes for your guh.
quest.guhs.ring.manteltje.hoe: Sneak and stand very still: then you look like a rock.
quest.guhs.ring.manteltje.rots: You look like a rock. Don't move, nyeg!
item.guhs.elfentouw.lore: Light as a feather and strong as a guh hug. Look at an Elven Rope Hook and right-click: the rope pulls you to it.
item.guhs.elfentouw.lore2: Reaches 24 blocks. Sneak to let go.
quest.guhs.ring.touw.geen_haak: The rope can't find a hook. Look at an Elven Rope Hook (no more than 24 blocks away).
quest.guhs.ring.touw.te_ver: That hook is too far away for the rope.
block.guhs.elfentouw_haak.lore: A little hook for the Elven Rope. Hang it on a wall or a ceiling, or put it on the ground.
block.guhs.ring_rustvuur.lore: A little cooking fire where travelers rest. It never burns your pawsies.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.nieuw: Rest stop reached! If you get spotted or caught, you come back here. Sam-guh puts the pan on the fire.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.gezellig: A cozy little cooking fire. This is where travelers rest, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.herinnering: This is where Sam-guh's stew tasted the very best.
quest.guhs.ring.rustpunt.al: The stew still needs to simmer. There'll be more tomorrow.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.0: I'm not going without you, boss. And not without my pans either, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.1: When we get home I'll plant nibble bushes everywhere. All the way to the fence.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.2: Did we bring the salty snacks? Without salt I'm not climbing any mountain.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.3: One paw in front of the other, boss. And a little snack in between.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.praat.4: I don't trust that ring. It's eyeing my sausages.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.eten.0: Garden stew, boss! With extra nibble. Go on, eat up.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.eten.1: It's not much, but it's warm. And there's cheese in it, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.eten.2: Po-ta-toes! Boil 'em, mash 'em, stick 'em in a stew. Here, for you.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.pruttelt: The pot still needs to simmer, boss. There'll be another stew tomorrow.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.zwaar: Boss, you're walking all hunched over. Is the ring that heavy? Just click me: I can't carry the ring, but I can carry you, nyeg!
quest.guhs.ring.sam.draag: I can't carry the ring, but I can carry you, nyeg! Hold on to my ears.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.aangekomen: There. From here you're on your own, boss. My pawsies are all wobbly.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.ring_terug: Boss! You dropped the ring. Here. Don't eat it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.niet_omdoen: Don't put it on, boss! The Eye will see you. Here in the Guhmension you can just about get away with it.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.andere_baas: I belong to another boss, nyeg. I can't leave them all alone.
quest.guhs.ring.sam.getemd: I'm coming home with you, boss. Forever. Do you have a garden there? Wahoog!
item.guhs.ring_vissenbotje.lore: Nibbled clean, right down to the bone. Right-click: your very own Smikagol comes scurrying over.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.niet_van_jou: We don't know you! We belong to another chonkie. Shhhh!
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.0: This way, chonkie! Smikagol knows the way. Nearly always.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.1: Walk softly, chonkie. The Eye has very big ears. No, eyes. One eye.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.2: We look after the chonkie. Very well. May Smikagol see it for a moment? No? Pity.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.gids.3: Don't cross the swamp with your mouth open, chonkie. It tastes like old sauce.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.kom.1: This way, chonkie! Smikagol is waiting. Smikagol doesn't like waiting.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.kom.2: Shhhh! Over here! Before the riders come!
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.blijft: Smikagol stays here. By the water, if we may. Tasty fishesss.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.volgt: Smikagol walks along, chonkie. Behind you. Very close behind you.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.vis: Tasty fishesss! Caught %s. For you, chonkie. Smikagol already sneaked one for himself.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.bijt_nog_niet: They're not biting yet, chonkie. Little fishies are never in a hurry. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.0: Take Smikagol to water, chonkie. Then we catch fishesss for you.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.1: We are golden brown and sweet now. Mostly sweet.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.2: Sneak and click: then Smikagol stays put right where he is. Or walks along again.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.maatje.3: My chonkie... no, OUR chonkie. Sharing is tasty too, we have learned.
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.geroepen: Smikagol is already here, chonkie! Did you call? Is there fishesss?
quest.guhs.ring.smikagol.geen_maatje: Nobody comes. Smikagol only becomes your buddy after the story of the Nibble Ring.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.nog_niet: The party is waiting for you, once the ring has been shared. Until then we're saving you a piece of cake. A small piece.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.morgen: You've already had today's treat, nyeg. There's another party tomorrow!
quest.guhs.ring.feest.traktatie.0: Party in the Shire! Here, a Party Nibble. One a day, or you'll roll right down the hill.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.traktatie.1: Hip hip, nyeg! A Party Nibble for the Ring-Bearer.
quest.guhs.ring.feest.traktatie.2: There's always something to celebrate. Today: that it's today. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.titels.hint.ringdrager: Bring the Nibble Ring to Mount Fry and share it with everyone
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.voor.0: A wizard is never late, nyeg. Nor is he early. He arrives precisely when there are nibbles.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.voor.1: I'm looking for someone with sturdy pawsies and an empty tummy. No, wait. Definitely NOT an empty tummy. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.reis.0: Fly, you foolish guhs! Well, alright. Just walk calmly. But in the right direction.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.reis.1: Don't eat that ring. Not even a tiny corner. I see everything, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.na.0: Fried and shared. That's how it should be with a nibble, nyeg. I'm proud of you.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhdalf.na.1: My fireworks have run out, but my appetite hasn't. Shall we throw another party?
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.voor.0: We wants it... the chonkie... Don't tell the chubby guhs, shhhh!
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.voor.1: Tasty fishesss. Raw and wriggly. Want one? No? Lucky us, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.reis.0: This way, chonkie! Smikagol knows a secret little path. Very secret. Very slippery.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.reis.1: It's ours... ours! Well, alright. Yours. For now. Shhhh.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.na.0: Smikagol is golden brown now. And crispy on the outside. It suits us, chonkie!
quest.guhs.ring.cast.smikagol.na.1: We got a piece. A WHOLE piece! Nobody took it away, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.voor.0: They call me Guhstrider. I sneak. You can't hear me. I can hear you, though: you smack your lips.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.voor.1: A king? Me? Oh no. I'm just a guh in a hood. Stop staring at my crown crumbs.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.reis.0: Sneaking is simple: tummy in, ears flat, and don't say 'nyeg'. That last one is the hardest.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.reis.1: If by my life or death I can protect the ring, I will. Preferably by my life, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.na.0: The nibble crown sits nicely. It just crumbles into my ears a little.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.araguh.na.1: A king shares his nibbles. It's the law. I wrote it myself, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.voor.0: My elf eyes see very far. There, behind that hill: a nibble. It's mine.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.voor.1: I've already found seventeen nibbles today. Don't tell Gimguh. Or actually, do.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.reis.0: They're taking the nibbles to Mount Fry! What do my elf eyes see? That it's a long walk, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.reis.1: Forty-one nibbles! Gimguh says forty-two, but that last one was already lying on the ground.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.na.0: In the end it was a tie. I don't like saying that. So I say it quietly.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.leguhlas.na.1: I live in the tree city now. The view is good. From here I can see what's in your backpack.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.voor.0: Nobody tosses a dwarf guh! Well, maybe across a teeny tiny ditch. When nobody's looking.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.voor.1: And my axe? That's for the cheese, nyeg. Thick slices.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.reis.0: Forty-two nibbles! That elf counts the crumbs as whole ones. Two can play at that game.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.reis.1: There's a secret little tunnel under this mountain. I'm not saying where. It's behind that rock over there.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.na.0: A tie with an elf. I lost three nights of sleep over it. Didn't lose a single meal, though.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.gimguh.na.1: My beard still smells like the fryer. I'm never washing it again, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.voor.0: I'm a Mika, yes. But I don't steal. Almost never. I'm practicing really hard.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.voor.1: One does not simply carry a single nibble to Mount Fry. You need buns to go with it, at the very least.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.reis.0: Let me hold the ring for a moment. Only hold it! No? No. You're right. Sorry. I'm ashamed, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.reis.1: I blow my horn when there's danger. Or when it's dinnertime. Mostly the second one.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.na.0: I was given a piece. Just given it! Without stealing. That was new for me.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.boromika.na.1: I guard the king's cookie jar now. Nothing has gone missing yet. Almost nothing.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.voor.0: We're looking for second breakfast. The first one was gone before we woke up.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.voor.1: Pippguh didn't do anything. Whatever it was. And I was standing right there and didn't see it either.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.reis.0: Is there anything tasty left in your backpack? We're only looking. With our pawsies.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.reis.1: That was Pippguh, with the bucket. All I did was tell him to do it, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.na.0: We've grown, can you tell? From the tree guhs' nibbles. At least one crumb taller.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.merrie.na.1: Third breakfast is a thing now too. We invented it, wahoog.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.voor.0: What about second breakfast? And elevenses? And the in-between nibble?
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.voor.1: I never touch anything. Except everything. But always by accident.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.reis.0: A bucket? What bucket? Oh, THAT bucket. It fell. All by itself. Down that well.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.reis.1: Fool of a Pippguh, Guhdalf says then. But he says it sweetly, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.na.0: I sang at the party. Everybody cried. From laughing, they said.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.pippguh.na.1: I never saw that well again. I think it saw me, though.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.voor.0: Welcome, traveler. This house is three thousand years old. So is the cheese sauce. Better not taste it.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.voor.1: I was there, back then. Three thousand years ago. When somebody ate the last nibble and said nothing.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.reis.0: The council has spoken. Well, shouted. You carry the ring. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.reis.1: Nine companions. So be it. Are there enough plates?
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.na.0: The ring has been shared. After three thousand years. I'd have liked a taste myself, to be honest.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhrond.na.1: Do drop by. The waterfalls run with fresh cheese sauce now. THAT you may taste.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.voor.0: I know what you seek. It's in the fridge. In my house we always know everything.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.voor.1: Even the smallest guh can change the course of dinner.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.reis.0: Look into the mirror, if you dare. You'll see what was, what is, and what you're having for dinner tonight.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.reis.1: Three gifts I give you. Don't lose them. And wash the little cloak on a cold cycle, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.na.0: The shadow is gone and the fryer is on. These are good times.
quest.guhs.ring.cast.guhladriel.na.1: The phial still glows, I see. Handy in the pantry, wahoog.
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_guhda: Talk to Guhdalf at the big Barbecue Pit
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_gekre: One Nibble to Share Them All
Receive the Nibble Ring. Don't eat it, nyeg
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_sam.d: Sam-guh walks along with you, with all his pans
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_rustp: Reach a rest stop: this is where you come back to if you get caught
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_stoof: Have Sam-guh cook you a stew at a rest fire
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_kwijl: Walk past wild guhs with the ring: they trail after you, drooling
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_omged: Put the Nibble Ring on anyway. Mikas can't see you anymore. The Eye can
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_negen: Escape the nine Skelly Mika Riders
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_gaven: Receive the Light Phial, the Little Elven Cloak and the Elven Rope
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_verbl: Dazzle a Skelly Mika Rider with the Light Phial
Sneak and stand still with the Little Elven Cloak: you look like a rock
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_elfen: Let the Elven Rope pull you to a hook
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_gedra: Let Sam-guh carry you when the ring gets too heavy
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_klaar: Bring the Nibble Ring to Mount Fry, have it fried and share it with everyone
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_smika: Smikagol is your buddy: put him by the water and he catches fish for you
advancements.guhs.knabbelring.ring_feest: Pick up your daily treat at the party in the Nibble Shire
structure.guhs.ring_rustpunt.tooltip: A little camp with a rest fire: Sam-guh cooks here and this is where you come back to if the Nine catch you (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhaal.reiskaart.knabbelring: The Journey of the Nibble Ring
quest.guhs.ring.terug.barbecuerog: SWISH! The Barbecuerog's bratwurst whip got you. He put you neatly back at your rest fire. You do smell like barbecue now, nyeg.
quest.guhs.ring.terug.poortwachter: A Grill Guard spotted you and shoved you back to your rest stop. "No guhs allowed, it says so right there, doesn't it?"
quest.guhs.ring.terug.ringh6_frituur: Nearly fried! The Smoke Guhlings fished you out and put you at your rest stop. Nyeg.
